select DISTINCT as_of_date from EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT where DEP_Account_Status = 'C' and as_of_date between '2022-12-01' and '2025-01-29' order by 1
group by gam_acid, as_of_date
having count(1)>1
order by 1

,'PA5136229'
)
